title: Gold’s been wild this week, bot caught most of the swings — some takeaways
author: Hot-Mixture109
selftext:
Been running my algo on XAUUSD (M30) through this chop between ~$3970-4130, and wanted to share a few observations:

	•	Range-bound whipsaws are brutal for signal density. You can see the bot flipping direction fast around the $4000-4020 zone — a lot of quick reversals there, but it’s what let it stay positioned for the bigger move down to $3970 and back up.
	•	The bounce off $3970 was the cleanest signal of the week. Tight cluster of confirming arrows right at the low, then a strong ride back up past $4060.
	•	The fakeout rejection near $4085 today is a good example of why I don’t let it chase every spike — it flagged the reversal fast instead of holding through it.
